notes.title: Sam & MaRU is Released!
notes.content:
Sam & MaRU is now available to play on Steam! Take control of a robot in this programming, puzzle-solving game as you take care of problems around Singularity Corporation's factory. Don’t worry, Singularity has everyone’s best interest at heart and would never be planning something sinister...
